5. Load the procedure with `feedback`: the newest review summary carrying `Verdict: READY_FOR_HUMAN` whose `Reviewed head:` is this exact head, and the numbered procedure under its `## Human verification` section. When no such summary exists and the CI reviewer that `## CI review` names, or an automated reviewer that `## CI gate` names, cleared this exact head, use the pull request body's `## Human verification` section instead. Use that section too when the user accepted a review's findings as they are: a conversation comment headed `## Review accepted`, with a `Reason:` line, whose `Accepted head:` is this head, or a head that only clean merges of the base separate from this one. When none of these exists, post nothing and end with `Status: BLOCKED_FOR_SYNC`: the head needs a clean review first.
